texts.zh:
新的博物天枢业已在[from.GetName]建成，我们有机会重建在生态园所失去的大部分东西。

我们从之前养育的太空兽群物种身上采集的基因物质都有妥善保存，只要有足够的资源就可以克隆出新的幼体。
texts.en:
Now that a new Grand Archive has been established in [from.GetName], we have an opportunity to restore much of what was lost from our Vivarium.

Genetic Material from each Space Fauna species we have previously raised has been preserved, and with enough resources we can clone new hatchlings.
